profile.name: Saptak Nandi
profile.headline: Computer science student building calm, clear, useful web products.
profile.summary: Focused on full-stack apps, AI-assisted learning tools, and developer-facing automation. I like projects that solve a real task and explain themselves through the interface.
profile.about: From adaptive quiz systems to code review helpers, my work usually starts with a small friction point and turns into a product with structure, logic, and a readable UI. I care about making technical ideas easier to use, not just easier to demo.
profile.availability: Available for internships and collaborative web projects
profile.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering,TEchno Institute of Engineering and Management ,MAKAUT (2024-2028)
profile.contactBlurb: I am especially interested in internships, thoughtful product teams, and projects where design clarity matters as much as the underlying logic.

focusAreas.label: Frontend
focusAreas.title: Readable UI systems
focusAreas.description: I enjoy building interfaces that feel lightweight, structured, and easy to scan on both mobile and desktop.

focusAreas.label: Backend
focusAreas.title: Practical APIs and tooling
focusAreas.description: Most of my backend work is about simple data flows, routing, storage, and keeping the overall system easy to reason about.

focusAreas.label: Applied AI
focusAreas.title: Useful intelligence, not just novelty
focusAreas.description: I like AI when it helps adapt a learning path, summarize logic, or automate repetitive review work without making the product opaque.

projects.title: AI-Powered Adaptive Quiz System
projects.description: A full-stack learning app that adjusts question difficulty based on user performance, aiming to keep practice sessions challenging without turning them frustrating.
projects.highlight: Real-time difficulty tuning with a learner-focused workflow.

projects.title: Automated Code Review Assistant
projects.description: A tool built for fast technical feedback during short development cycles, surfacing syntax issues and likely logic mistakes before manual review starts.
projects.highlight: Designed to shorten the first review pass during rapid builds.

projects.title: Digital Logic Simulator
projects.description: A browser-based simulator for core electronics concepts, giving students a more interactive way to understand components like flip-flops, encoders, and decoders.
projects.highlight: Turns abstract classroom topics into something visual and testable.

projects.title: Linear Regression Analysis Tool
projects.description: A data exploration project that visualizes datasets and uses regression models to surface patterns, trends, and prediction signals in a readable format.
projects.highlight: Blends model output with charts that help explain the result.
